content.body: (I am trying to swing back to this with tests -- just snowdrifted under other things, so probably next week unfortunately)
What was the details here, Anne?
If you click "More" in OP there's the output, no? And our CI didn't have such output.
Ah whoops, didn't realize where I was supposed to look.

Ah, found the issue. Well, the issue is exactly what the error message says - Bikeshed looks for repository info locally (so it finds it when you run locally, from the spec's repo) but then it can't find that info when it's run externally. Looks like WHATWG shoudl be able to easily add a computed `Repository` metadata to handle everything, tho.
